text:
Chemical | Technical Procedure
Introduction
Denver Instrument 
 is easy to use, easily adapted to most operating environments through 
 simple adjustments from the keyboard. Denver Instrument will display the 
 weight directly in grams.
The first draft 
 was initiated by chemist: Hanaa Hamza, Reviewed by chemical general 
 director: Salem Abd Ella, and accepted by Eng.Gomaa Khater, the Head Sector 
 of Kafr Eldwar power Station.
This document is approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat 
 quality control and 
Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator 
 at WDEPC.
Safety precautions
The weighing table should be 
 solid and free from vibration drafts (such as opening doors or windows) and 
 as level as possible.
Corners of rooms are best as they 
 are less prone to vibrations.
Dont install the balance near 
 heaters or air conditioners.
Dont install the balance in 
 direct sunlight.
Dont use the balance near other 
 equipment which produces magnetic fields.
Suitable room dry and clean
Accuracy
To ensure that you get 
the most from your balance:
Warm-up (plug-in) 
 the balance for at least one hour.
The weighing room 
 should be kept clean and dry.
Make each weighing 
 quickly to avoid errors due to changes in environ conditions.
Close the breeze 
 break doors to keep out drafts.
Dont drop things 
 upon the weighing pan or place a weight beyond the range balance on the 
 weighing pan. .
Tools and 
Equipment
1) 
 Denver Instrument 
 AA 200.
2) 
 Safety table 
 for putting balance as level as possible.
Worked to be carried out
Display ON : OFF & 
Power Errors
The balance does a 
 self check when you connect the AC adapter or press the ON: OFF key. If 
 there is a problem, you will get an error display. To 
 clear this error press the Tare key.
Calibration
Warm up the 
 balance for at least one hour with nothing on the weighing pan, Turn the 
 display on.
Press and hold the 
 Tare key the display will read zero.
Place known 
 calibration mass on the pan ( for Exp 100, 200 gm).
Press the auto. 
 Cal key.
The balance will 
 display the calibration mass( Cal 100-)(Cal -200-). Then the balance 
 measures the calibration mass value.
Remove the 
 calibration mass from the pan, The balance will return to normal weighing 
 mode automatically.
Simple Weighing
Turn the display 
 on using the ON:OFF key. After a moment zero will be displayed if 
 (zero) not be display press the tare key,(zero) will be displayed.
If you are using a 
 tare container, place it on the weighing pan, The display will show the 
 container weight.
Press the tare 
 key to cancel the weight.
Place the object 
 to be weighed in the container.
Wait for the 
 stabilization and read the weight.
Remove the object 
 from the pan.
Turn the display 
 OFF using the ON:OFF key.
